MTM-02-IM · 2.2 Slip and torqueWorksheet 2.2-A: torque against slip from the FEMM model of the kit motor, and the field at three slips.

At the chosen slip

Torque against slip, at rated stator current

Each point is one time-harmonic FEMM solution of the kit cross-section at the slip frequency fs = s·f, with 1.93 A rms in every phase. Pick a slip to read it.

Parameters

No-load and locked-rotor tests, motor in delta

Line values as the meters read them. Edit any cell; the parameters update. The method follows IEC 60034-28 in a simplified form: equal leakage reactances, X1 = X2′.

LabelMeaning
C ConfirmedMeasured on the kit, or from its datasheet or nameplate.
I InferredWorked out from other values. Every FEMM result and everything this app calculates is Inferred.
T Training targetChosen for the exercise. Never report it as measured.
NA Not availableNot known yet.
